purpose: Prevent self-estimated controls and self-measured candidate landmarks from becoming the effective reference authority in an existing-object reproduction task.
rules: candidate Source may never become its own target authority
designer estimates can constrain an iteration but cannot establish final Reference Fidelity PASS
same-generation licensed reference geometry may control primary body/greenhouse proportions while exact-revision imagery controls changed fascia/details
ground-truth geometry is READ_ONLY_REFERENCE and never promoted to project Source Authority
if downloadable ground-truth is unavailable, record that limitation and use independently measured multi-view image targets
a reference target and candidate measurement must have different provenance
required_final_evidence: at least one non-designer primary-form reference
same-revision visual evidence for identity-bearing changed features
multi-view comparison on the same candidate Source digest
forbidden: copyright_or_NoAI_restricted_geometry_used as generative input contrary to its terms
reference geometry replacing editable Source Authority
